references.text: Moses' warning not to add to or take away from the law, parallel to Jesus' statement about the immutability of the law.
David's declaration that the Lord's word stands firm forever, resembling Jesus' words about the permanence of heaven and earth in relation to the law.
The prophet Isaiah's words that God's word stands firm forever, consistent with Jesus' statement about the endurance of the law.
The author of Hebrews speaks of God's unchanging word, which resonates with Jesus' words about the immutability of the law.
